headline: September 21 lithium battery industry news roundup: lithium carbonate price rebounds to 130,450 yuan/ton; Xiaomi releases "Longkai" battery, fire does not spread, with lifetime guarantee; check now
summary: The Shanghai Metals Market mid-price for battery-grade lithium carbonate rose 200 yuan per tonne to 130,450 yuan. August national output was about 96,000 tons, down 2.5% month on month.
why: Lithium carbonate is a key input for lithium-ion batteries, so its price affects battery makers and electric vehicle costs.
